The horizontal axis is number of foreign countries visited, from surrounding text, with marks from 0 to 11 at each integer and arrows on both ends. China: A single horizontal line segment with vertical end caps from about 0 to about 5. No box is drawn, so first quartile, median, and third quartile are not drawn as distinct parts. Minimum is about 0 and maximum is about 5.

The dashed right edge at about 8 is the median sitting on the box edge, indicating median about 8 and third quartile about 8 at the same position. A right whisker goes from about 8 to a maximum cap at about 11.

United States: A box spans from about 0 to about 5. Its solid left edge at about 0 indicates first quartile and also minimum about 0, with no left whisker drawn beyond it. Inside the box a dashed vertical line at about 2 indicates the median. The solid right edge at about 5 indicates third quartile. A right whisker extends from about 5 to a maximum cap at about 11.

Overall, China shows the smallest range capped at about 5. Germany shows higher counts with half at about 8 or more. The United States shows a low median of about 2 with at least a quarter at about 0, but with a long right tail to about 11.

Each box plot has a short vertical cap at the minimum, a horizontal whisker line to the left edge of the box, a rectangular box, a dashed vertical line inside the box for the median, a horizontal whisker line from the right edge of the box to a short vertical cap at the maximum.
